# Mirebrook Rail - timetable service

Signage controllers poll the timetable service, so it should come back on its own after the host or the
container runtime is restarted. Operators still stop the service by hand during engineering work.

turns.prompt: Mirebrook Rail's timetable service should come back by itself after a host restart or a runtime restart, but it must stay down when an operator has stopped it by hand. Give the container field and the value that produce exactly that behaviour. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
